steps.description: Requested artifact exists and meets acceptance criteria

verify.manual: Given the original goal, constraints and relevant sources, inspect the combined report end to end; assess whether every requested outcome is satisfied and cite content/integration evidence, naming any unsupported gap.

test_first_exempt.reason: Replace with test_first for behavior changes; keep a reason when a failing test first is not proportionate.

acceptance.description: Given the original request, constraints and relevant sources, when the combined report is reviewed end to end, then every requested outcome is satisfied with supported content.

_comment_allowed_paths: Optional schema-3 workspace-relative artifact prefixes, e.g. ["out", "build"]. Omit or use ["."] for the whole workspace; declarations only, not a shell sandbox.
